theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiHS_L1loc_limit_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (F : ℕ → Set (Rn N)) (G : Set (Rn N)), (∀ k, NullMeasurableSet (F k) volume) → NullMeasurableSet G volume → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → Tendsto (fun k ↦ volume (K ∩ symmDiff (F k) G)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → (∀ f : Rn N → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k ↦ ∫ y in F k, f y) atTop (𝓝 (∫ y in G, f y))) ∧ ∀ B : Set (Rn N), Bornology.IsBounded B → Tendsto (fun k ↦ volume (F k ∩ B)) atTop (𝓝 (volume (G ∩ B))) ∧ Tendsto (fun k ↦ volume (B \ F k)) atTop (𝓝 (volume (B \ G)))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
